test_item_verbatim: The Rear View Camera soft button shall be selectable only when the signal $PowerMode$ = [IGN_RUN].

tcs.tc_title: soft key gated by RUN, read the App Drawer and check that "Rear View Camera" is selectable
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in the Full-Operation state
2. PROXI Rear_View_Camera = 1 (Present)
3. The shift lever is in P
4. No camera image is displayed
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "Apps" on Menu Bar to open App Drawer
2. Read the App Drawer and check that "Rear View Camera" is selectable
tcs.expected_result:
1. The App Drawer is displayed
2. The "Rear View Camera" entry is shown in the available state and can be selected
tcs.test_item:
The Rear View Camera soft button shall be selectable only when the signal $PowerMode$ = [IGN_RUN].

(soft key gated by RUN, read the App Drawer and check that "Rear View Camera" is selectable)

reasoning: 驗證目標為 CFTS092 SYS-RA-CAM-073（ObjectID 4781638，Rear Camera 節）之「軟鍵僅於 $PowerMode$ = [IGN_RUN] 時可選取」之成立側。$PowerMode$ 為設定／參數標記（§8.7.5(f)），其 CAN 對應依 VF551_V2-534 為 BCM_FD_10.CmdIgnSts，故以 4 (RUN) 表達。**錨不取 VF551_V2-534** —— 該來源同為 SWE-CAM-003 所引，依 R-CAM10 委派 SWE-CAM-003。入口 hop 取 §5.3 已鎖定之 ENTER_APP_DRAWER 與 Menu Bar §4.1 naming table 之 "Rear View Camera"（NRL-127734）。不成立側（PowerMode != IGN_RUN）由 NR1L-RVC-024 承接。訊息名依 R-CAM3(e) 分寫於 CAN source 行。【CAM-06 §2-1】步 1 之 `Send CAN: BCM_FD_10.CmdIgnSts = 4 (RUN)` 已刪 —— Pre-Condition 1 之 Full-Operation 其定義已含 IGN RUN，重送為重複（審閱 §二-1，§4.4）；ER 隨之重編為兩項。【CAM-07 §2】Pre-Condition 3 之 CAN source 行**已刪**（DECISIONS 6-15，CAM-06 審閱 §二-3）——R-CAM3(e) 之句式為配合 `Send CAN` 步而設，步 1 既刪即無代換對象；`$PowerMode$ = [IGN_RUN]` 之前提由 `The HU is in the Full-Operation state` 一行承載。CAM-06 上繳 §5-5 所請之確認到此結案。
